get.summary: List incoming tickets and bugs once per task
get.description:
Additive union of existing ticket membership and bug kind; does not
create tasks or the hidden Tickets project. Requires tasks:read.
Scoped tokens use the live actor/token project intersection, including
queue access only when explicitly granted. Unselected projects remain
inaccessible. Archived projects and deleted tasks are excluded.
Needs triage selects ticket members in backlog columns, or unresolved
bugs without severity outside completed columns. All includes filed
and completed records. A task with both memberships appears once.
Both counts apply the same project, kind, severity and search filters,
independent of the selected scope and page. Severity selects bugs only.
Search includes title, description, typed bug details and exact current
or preserved task keys. Existing guarded lifecycle actions are unchanged.
Rows are ordered by immutable creation time then ID. Bounded opaque
keyset cursors retain filters, reader authority, a fixed read timestamp
and authorized project event/task-collection revisions. Changed filters
or reader authority return 400. A mutation since the prior page or
during rows/counts/enrichment returns 409 task_collection_changed with
details.restart=true; discard the cursor and restart from page one.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Narrow to a readable project ID, key or slug.

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: Select bugs by severity; none and untriaged mean null severity.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque Intake keyset cursor; omit for the first page. Offset cursors are not accepted.

200.description: Enriched canonical task page with filtered counts for both scopes.

409.description: The Intake collection changed; restart pagination from page one.

error.message: intake collection changed; restart pagination from the first page
